journal: Journal of Biomolecular Structure and Dynamics
snapshot_note: Snapshot for tests and as a starting point. The journal accepts format-free first submissions; an editable file is needed at revision. SubmitReady re-reads the live guidelines on every run.

sources.name: CSL styles repository: Journal of Biomolecular Structure and Dynamics

csl_style.title: Journal of Biomolecular Structure and Dynamics
csl_style.note: A dependent style of APA. The instructions page sets no reference style for first submission.

requirements.rule: Full name and affiliation of every author on the cover page; ORCID where available; one corresponding author with email
requirements.quote: All authors of a manuscript should include their full name and affiliation on the cover page of the manuscript.
Should contain an unstructured abstract of 250 words.

requirements.rule: Funding details, or a statement that no funding was obtained
requirements.quote: If no funding was obtained for the reported work, please declare that no funding was obtained.

requirements.rule: Disclosure statement, e.g. 'The authors report there are no competing interests to declare.'
requirements.quote: If there are no relevant competing interests to declare please state this within the article

requirements.rule: Declaration of generative AI use, also when none was used
requirements.quote: If generative AI was not used, please state this

requirements.rule: Data availability statement with a link, DOI or other persistent identifier where applicable
requirements.quote: Where applicable, this should include the hyperlink, DOI or other persistent identifier associated with the data set(s).

requirements.rule: Figures: 300 dpi for colour, 600 dpi for grayscale, 1200 dpi for line art; PS, JPEG, TIFF, or Word for figures drawn in Word
requirements.quote: Figures should be high quality (1200 dpi for line art, 600 dpi for grayscale and 300 dpi for colour, at the correct size).

requirements.rule: Graphical abstract is optional: 525 px wide, JPG, PNG or TIFF, a separate file named GraphicalAbstract1
requirements.quote: Please do not embed it in the manuscript file but save it as a separate file, labelled GraphicalAbstract1.
please ensure that equations are editable.

requirements.rule: CRediT roles for every author are entered during submission
requirements.quote: Submitting authors should be prepared to submit CRediT roles for themselves and their co-authors
